title: Product Spotlight: New ways to understand and engage your live audience
summary: We’re introducing new Live Analytics that give you a clearer view of your sales and audience, more ways to engage viewers, and new opportunities to turn early interest into active bidding and sales.
body_markdown:
Detailed listings help buyers discover what you’re selling, understand the item, and place a pre-bid before the show starts.


And now, we’re making those pre-bids work harder for you. If a buyer is outbid before your live show begins they’ll receive a notification that takes them directly back to the listing, giving them a chance to raise their bid.


The earlier buyers discover and bid on your inventory, the more opportunity you have to build competition and increase the sales price before you even go live.


Early results are promising: since we launched outbid notifications, daily prebidders are up 4% and pre-show pre-bids have increased 7%.


***How to use it:*** *List your strongest inventory before your show and give buyers enough detail to bid with confidence. Use clear photos and titles, add the right category and product details, and make listings available early enough for buyers to discover them. Once they place a pre-bid, outbid notifications can help bring them back if the auction moves past them.*


### **Also this month: Seller Provided Support Rolling Out Across the US**


A quick reminder that Seller Provided Support (SPS) started rolling out to all US sellers on September 1.


SPS gives you ownership of buyer support requests and the tools to resolve issues directly with buyers. Most sellers are already using SPS to provide support and build buyer trust.


Whether you’re already on SPS or will be soon, here are a few things to keep in mind:


-


Respond to each buyer request individually, even if the same buyer submits multiple requests.


-


If you need more time to investigate, respond within two business days and let the buyer know you're working on it.


-


Monitor your SPS Response Rate. Once your initial 30-day period ends, it will count toward Premier Shop eligibility and Account Health.


Join our Product live, September 30, at 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET / 7:00 PM BST on @whatnotsellers to learn more about navigating SPS and get some of your product questions answered. Save and join the show[here](https://www.whatnot.com/live/3c24e5f8-e05d-48c0-8887-fa62cba6f397) .


Happy selling!


– Whatnot Product Team
